integrity.claim_scope: Two explicitly described four-world models with the same complete valuation, uniform local convex neighborhood families, full unary-fragment support equivalence; a fixed strict conditional separates them.
integrity.computational_evidence: Independent finite checks in verify_convex.py and direct_semantic_test.py; numerical data are not substituted for the unbounded-language proof.

scientific_limitations: Separation on convex inhabited neighborhood models; no claim of minimal four-world size or of expressive completeness. Does not settle convex-invariance completeness Conjecture 4.11. Literature priority is best knowledge, not exhaustive.
title: A four-world convex-neighborhood separation of the binary inquisitive conditional
